summary: Completed targeted backend+frontend regression for community invite and dense world updates. Backend read/regression tests passed (11/11). Core invite copy flow, fallback behavior, dense world counts, responsive checks, and preview assets passed. Two scope items remain blocked/unverified in this environment.

integration_issues.flow: Community invite from conversation page canonicalization
integration_issues.issue: Could not execute required /community/:id/post/:postId copy-canonical test because public feed has 0 posts (no available postId).

integration_issues.flow: Native navigator.share success/AbortError/rejection branches via TEST-ONLY override
integration_issues.issue: In this headless browser harness, navigator.share stays undefined and runtime prototype stubs are ignored, so success/AbortError/rejection branches could not be conclusively validated. Unsupported-share fallback path works.

action_items: Add/enable a deterministic TEST-ONLY hook for navigator.share branch simulation so success/AbortError/rejection can be reliably automated in headless QA.
Provide at least one public community post fixture for canonical copy test from /community/:id/post/:postId route.
Re-run final invite branch validation on a real mobile browser where native OS share sheet is available.
critical_code_review_comments: CommunityInvite copy behavior is correct: canonical URL copied, copied state resets (~2.2s), and clipboard failure does not show false success.
Dense world instrumentation is consistent: data-scenery-buildings=7406 and data-token-buildings=5; token labels for fartcoin/arc/ban/jellyjelly/ansem are visible.
Home and product preview assets load from refreshed /previews files (world-scene.jpg and world-preview.jpg present and valid).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: no-login invite buttons for fartcoin/arc, clipboard success+reset, clipboard denial fallback message with readonly URL, unsupported share opens dialog, mobile 390/320 no horizontal overflow and no bottom-nav overlap, world dense counts 7406/5, label click and near-tower click route to token page, backend world/community regressions passed. Remaining: native share branch validation and conversation-page canonical copy once a post exists.
rca of the issue: Unverified items were blocked by environment/state constraints rather than confirmed functional failures: (1) zero public posts prevented real /post/:postId conversation invite-copy validation; (2) headless preview browser reported navigator.share as undefined and ignored runtime stub attempts, so native-share success/AbortError/rejection branch outcomes could not be deterministically exercised here.
